Before you begin

Questions,
answered.

Everything important about editing, templates, and downloads.

Is the resume builder really free to use?+

Yes. Choosing a template, editing the complete resume, and previewing your work are free. Payment is required only when you want to download the finished PDF.

What do I receive for $5?+

One purchase adds three PDF download credits to your account. It is not a subscription and does not renew automatically.

Will the editor use the actual template?+

Yes. The editor opens the selected template with all available pages and its original visual layout—not just a matching theme color.

Can I upload a profile photo?+

Photo upload is available when the selected template contains a supported photo element. You can also adjust its crop and position.

Which file format can I download?+

The current download product is a print-ready PDF. We do not currently advertise Word or Google Docs export.
